name: open-simple-mail
description: A self-hosted, open-source webmail client for managing multiple mailboxes.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @osm/shared && npm run build -w @osm/web && npm run build -w @osm/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @osm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @osm/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @osm/server" "npm run dev -w @osm/web"

author: OpenSimpleMail contributors
